findings.claim: GrafanaGroupLoader calls promResponse.data.groups.at(0)?.rules.map(...) without optional chaining on .map. An empty groups array therefore causes undefined.map(...) to throw.

verifier.reason: public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:227 now calls groupIdentifier.fromCombinedRule(rule) in a render-time useMemo, which for non-Grafana rules calls getDatasourceAPIUid (utils/groupIdentifier.ts:22), and that throws `Datasource "..." not found` when the name is not in getAllDataSources() (utils/datasource.ts:303-305); the replaced getRulesSourceName (utils/datasource.ts:238-240) only returns a name and cannot throw.
